title: Good quality, reasonably priced desk/table
text: Good quality, reasonably priced desk/table. This Decoholic computer desk is surprisingly nice for the money. Nicely made, good quality and super easy to put together (took me about 10 minutes and I am usually technically challenged when it comes to this stuff). Super functional, nice size, it can be used as a desk or even as just a place to showcase items in your home. I already had a desk in my home (one with drawers) and I am using this as a place to put my printer. Highly recommend!

product_metadata.title: Decoholic Computer Desk 55  Modern Simple Large Study Writing Desk Industrial Style Laptop PC Table for Home Office, with Leg Bars, Oak Board Black Leg…
features: This computer desk combines natural inspiration with modern design. Its unique oak wood grain shows natural flair and elegant taste. The classic color can make you feel peaceful and comfortable. It's a great match for any decor.
The desktop is made of quality laminated MDF which is waterproof, fireproof and anti-hot, anti-scratch and easy to clean. The edge banding is specially processed and feels smooth.

The computer desk frame is made of powder-coated sand-finish steel with two leg bars on either side to ensure stability and durability.1.57" by 1.57" width of legs are strong enough to support heavy articles. The triangular junction design makes the frame sturdier. The frame and all legs are anti rust.
Easy to install. Only need to install 4 legs and 2 support bars with hex key. Instruction, screws, and tools are packaged separately.
Dimensions: 55L * 23.6W * 29.5H inches (140L * 60W * 75H cm). Package weights about 40.08lbs (18.18 kg). Maximum load capacity 300 lbs (136kg).
